name: educonnect
description: EduConnect MVP monorepo with a Laravel API and separate planned student and administration surfaces.

scripts.format: pnpm --recursive --if-present run format && composer --working-dir=apps/api exec pint
scripts.format:check: pnpm --recursive --if-present run format:check && composer --working-dir=apps/api exec pint -- --test
scripts.check: pnpm run versions:check && pnpm run format:check && pnpm run analyse && pnpm run contracts:check && pnpm run lint && pnpm run typecheck && pnpm run test && pnpm run build
